_readme: [pt19 v1.0 / spec S4.1, S4.5, S9; capability map U11] The SHIPPED dialogue overrides (design 5.4), data only. lrgDlgOverrides() reads this file AND the owner's lrg_dialogue_overrides.json: the owner's `entries` rules come first (first match wins), these after them, so an owner file never shadows them by merely existing (model F32). An entries rule matches index fields by glob, case-insensitive (topic, quest, text = the live line, info = the resolved INFO key such as skyrim.esm:04DE3C). commit: true = the line cannot be undone - the two-step asks once unless his own plain sentence already said it (S4.3) and a single-entry layer releases only on his assent or the line's own words (S4.5). never_auto: true = never picked on the words alone (never explicit), always her naming question first. fcommit: true = a follower commit (a dismissal): a commit wherever it is resolved, never explicit. class: forces the class (plain / commit / ...). [pt19h-grading / G19, G20, G14 traps, Brotherhood C15] Every trap the pt19x coverage found graded plain, back, service or meta is listed below with its evidence. LIMIT (pt19h-grading r2, open, owner of the S4.5 single-entry release): never_auto and fcommit bind the explicit test, the intent path and the two-step (she asks); a line that is ALONE on its layer is still released by lrgDlgSingleEntryRelease on his assent or on its own words, which read neither flag yet - 'she asks first' below holds where the line has siblings.

entries._why: the Legion oath's last line ('Long live the Emperor! Long live the Empire!') - a commit by its goodbye flag too; listed so both oath rows read the same
the Stormcloak oath's last line ('All hail the Stormcloaks, the true sons and daughters of Skyrim!') carries no goodbye flag, so no heuristic sees it as a commit

Alternate Perspective's start ('Give me your best room. (<RoomCost> gold) (Start Intro)') - its price bracket is not last, so it reads cost 0 and would be a free service line. never_auto = she quotes the line and asks first; 'yes' clicks it.
